verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird's materials include a TwoVenture start-up guidance hub, a German term sheet generator, and employee-incentive factsheets (EMI, Growth Shares, CSOP, SIP). None of the evidence documents founder equity mechanics: no founder vesting schedules, no 83(b) election or local equivalent, and no guidance on co-founder equity splits. The employee-incentive and financing materials are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm's own materials cover founder equity mechanics — vesting schedules, 83(b) elections or the local equivalent, and equity splits among co-founders — so day-zero ownership is set up right
